production.direction_en: The gallery contains portraits with their nameplates cut away. Mirel and Aveline arrive with the cathedral folio; Odelia's message found them. In one portrait, a court official's gloved hand rests beside a watch with no hands.
production.music_direction_en: pre: bgm_ch6_estate (uneasy layer) | post: bgm_fadyme_theme + bgm_ledger_motif together on 'She was my mother.'

commands.speaker: mirel_quill
commands.text: Someone removed the names but left the faces. A very specific kind of cowardice.

commands.speaker: sister_aveline
commands.text: Or a person trying to hide the victims from the rite.

commands.speaker: hana_birch
commands.text: This woman has the same bell pin as Fadyme.
